children: Akamai announced a suite of material agreements to accelerate its cloud and infrastructure scale. The company entered Project Plan 2 and Project Plan 3 under its MSA with Anthropic, featuring an approximate $11.6 billion aggregate commitment over initial seven-year terms for dedicated AI cloud capacity and managed services. In connection with Project Plan 3, Akamai issued Anthropic a warrant to purchase up to 387,051 Series B Non-Voting Convertible Preferred shares, vesting as Anthropic expands its contractual commitments. Akamai also signed a multi-year hardware and services supply pact with Lenovo and authorized Jabil to procure about $1.7 billion of memory components under its manufacturing program, reinforcing supply for customized server builds.
